blocks.text: STOCKHOLM, Sweden — Research in particle physics, astrophysics or the invention of an “invisibility cloak” are some of the achievements that could be honored when the Nobel physics prize is awarded Tuesday. The award, to be announced at 11:45 am (0945 GMT) in Stockholm, is the second Nobel of the season, after the Medicine Prize was awarded on Monday to US psychiatrist and neurologist Karl Deisseroth and German scientists Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel. The researchers were honored for their pioneering work in the field of optogenetics, which involves controlling nerve signals with light. READ: Nobel prize in medicine goes to […]...
